email_text:
Hey,

Hope you're doing well! It's been a minute since we last spoke, things have
been pretty hectic on my end. I switched up my whole schedule this month
trying to balance a few different commitments, and honestly it's been a bit
of a juggling act. Anyway, I wanted to reach out about a few things.

First off, I finally got around to setting up that thing we talked about a
while back, and it's actually working out better than I expected. Took a
bit of trial and error but I think I've got a good system going now. I'll
show you sometime if you're curious.

Also, random thought, but I've been meaning to ask — what time do you guys
open till during the week? I might swing by sometime this week or next
depending on how my schedule shakes out, and I don't want to show up when
you're closed lol. Let me know whenever you get a chance, no rush at all.

On a completely different note, I've also been getting into a new hobby
lately and it's honestly consuming way more of my free time than I
expected, but I'm not mad about it. Might tell you more about it next time
we actually catch up properly instead of over email.

Anyway, hope everything's going well on your end too. Talk soon!

Best,
